summary: Added deterministic ecosystem hash projection to release provenance and Alpha runtime artifact gates.
acceptance_evidence: build-release.ps1 writes provenance.ecosystem with registry_snapshot, lockfile, staged_set, active_set and replay hash projections.
Directory hashes are deterministic over sorted relative file paths and file hashes.
The registry snapshot projection is required and present.
Staged, active and replay projections are distinct and currently optional until later activation/replay tasks.
The provenance records install_stage_is_activation=false and activation_authority=AgentCore PlanSpec + SecurityExecutionEngine.
Alpha runtime artifact gates now include ecosystem.registry_snapshot.

commands.summary: Release provenance generated with ecosystem hash projection; promotion status remains blocked because heavyweight gates were intentionally skipped.

blocked_shortcuts: Staged and active artifact hashes are not conflated.
Missing ecosystem replay is not a Wave 4 hard blocker; it is recorded as required after TASK-VERIFY-041.
Provenance does not mark skipped release gates as promotable.
promotion_impact: Release provenance can now bind local ecosystem inputs before activation and ecosystem replay gates are implemented.
